scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/brand && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/agent-host && tsc -p packages/catalog && tsc -p packages/teacher-mcp && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run coverage
scripts.desktop: npm run build:ui && npm start -w packages/desktop
scripts.serve: npm run build:ui && APORIA_UI_DIR=packages/ui/dist node packages/server/src/serve-main.ts
scripts.smoke:desktop: npm run build:ui && npm run build -w packages/desktop && node packages/desktop/e2e/smoke.ts
scripts.e2e:desktop: npm run build:ui && npm run build -w packages/desktop && node packages/desktop/e2e/smoke.ts && node packages/desktop/e2e/editor.ts && node packages/desktop/e2e/recover.ts
